parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be globally unique. The value cannot exceed 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). For more information, see How to ensure idempotence.

parameters.name: Constraints
parameters.description:
The constraints of the parameter. By default, this parameter is empty. Valid values:

- AllowedValues: the allowed values of the parameter. The value is a string of the array type.

- AllowedPattern: a regular expression string.

- MinLength: the minimum length of the parameter.

- MaxLength: the maximum length of the parameter.

parameters.name: DKMSInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the KMS instance.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the parameter. The description cannot exceed 200 characters in length.

parameters.name: KeyId
parameters.description: The ID of the KMS key used for encryption.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The parameter name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The name cannot exceed 180 characters in length and cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The parameter type. Valid values: Secret.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The parameter value. The value cannot exceed 4,096 characters in length.
